source: Four independent public impact metrics for 2025-26, joined by normalized name: EPM (Dunks & Threes season-actual), DARKO DPM, LEBRON (Basketball Index) and RAPM (nbarapm.com, LEBRON-prior variant). Each carries its total plus the offense/defense split. 500-minute floor on every source that reports minutes. Used to validate Apron Value, not to compute it.
